instruction: Put my things where they belong.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
mug = obs["objects"]["yellow_mug"]
cyan_tray = obs["zones"]["cyan_tray"]

# Check if cyan_tray is empty
if any(obj for obj in obs["objects"].values() if obj["center"][0] == cyan_tray["center"][0] and obj["center"][1] == cyan_tray["center"][1]):
    # Clear cyan_tray by moving its contents to orange_tray
    for obj in obs["objects"].values():
        if obj["center"][0] == cyan_tray["center"][0] and obj["center"][1] == cyan_tray["center"][1]:
            # Pick the object
            pick(obj["name"], 0.02, 0.0)
            # Place it in orange_tray
            place("orange_tray")
            break

# Now move yellow_mug to cyan_tray
pick("yellow_mug", 0.02, mug["long_axis_yaw"])
place("cyan_tray")

constraints: The cyan_tray must be clear before placing the yellow_mug on it.
The orange_tray currently holds the yellow_mug, so it must be cleared before placing the blue_book on it.

task_spec.refined_instruction: First, move the yellow_mug from the orange_tray to the cyan_tray. Before doing so, ensure the cyan_tray is empty; if not, clear it first. Then, move the blue_book from its current location (not on any zone) to the orange_tray. Before placing the blue_book, ensure the orange_tray is empty; if not, clear it by moving the yellow_mug to the cyan_tray first. Success is achieved when the yellow_mug is on the cyan_tray and the blue_book is on the orange_tray, with no other objects on those zones.
